text:
rachel: deploybot blocked stable publish for tag 2026.03.21-stable in gcr (eu-central1) — provenance-guard rejected cosign signature due to timestamp outside accepted window. :warning:

ben: ugh. any logs?

rachel: publish job excerpt:
```
[push] pushed manifestlist sha256:aa11bb22
[verify] cosign verify --key ksm://… gcr.io/myproj/app@sha256:aa11bb22
ERROR: verification failed: signature timestamp 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z older than allowed skew (policy: not-before 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z)
provenance-guard: reject
```

deploybot: Promotion halted  reason: signature-timestamp-skew. Auto-hold applied. To unhold provide re-signed attestation or `@deploybot unhold 1812341111` with justification.

ikram: This happened because the signing machine clock is slightly behind during the build matrix run. Two quick mitigations: 1) re-sign the artifact with current time and push attestation, or 2) pin routing to previous stable digest until we can re-sign within change window.

sam: Re-sign sounds clean but may require key access and extra CI step. Pinning is faster and safer short-term. Rollback criteria?
achel: Rollback criteria if pinned route causes >1% error budget burn or customer errors spike. If that happens, revert to previous digest and rollback the release.

ikram: Plan:
- immediate: pin stable route to previous digest sha256:99887766 (routing PR)
- schedule: trigger `ci/re-sign-attestation` job at 16:00 UTC to create new cosign attestation and push to GCR
- verification: after re-sign, run `cosign verify` and then `@deploybot unhold 1812341111` with verification logs
- follow-up: add a clock-check step to CI builder and a pre-publish cosign verify with timestamp sanity check

ben: I can open the routing PR now to pin. I'll include the rollforward plan and a release_notes blurb: "2026.03.21 - stable pinned due to cosign timestamp skew; re-sign scheduled; CI clock-check added."

sam: I'll stand by to run the re-sign job if the orchestrator ACLs block CI. Command we'll run if manual: ```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/… gcr.io/myproj/app@sha256:aa11bb22 --timestamp $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
# push attestation blob to registry
```

ikram: After re-sign, tests: `cosign verify --time-window` and `gcloud container images describe --show-occurrence` (or our provenance API) to confirm.
achel: TL;DR: hold applied, routing pin PR opened by ben, re-sign job scheduled at 16:00 UTC, unhold after verification. I'll post unhold when done. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Log: hold created at 1812341111 by deploybot. State=HOLD. Actions recorded: pin digest, re-sign attestation, CI clock-check patch.
